scientific_integrity: Mathematical result proved using a finite-rank Gaussian-to-Haar coupling and independent rare-event Laplace functionals; simulation is diagnostic only.
scientific_limitations: Only Haar Stiefel induced planar and spatial polygon ensembles of total perimeter 2
No conditioning on equilateral edges, self-avoidance, or knot type
Compact-threshold probability comparison, no full-vector total-variation estimate
Log-log centering for spatial longest edges has slow finite-sample convergence
title: Two-sided Poisson extreme-edge laws for Haar-frame closed polygons
